user1.story: I've been feeling completely hopeless for weeks now. Everything feels pointless and I don't see any reason to keep going. Work is a disaster, my relationships are falling apart, and I just can't handle it anymore. I've been thinking a lot about ending it all, like maybe taking a bunch of pills so I can finally sleep forever and not wake up to this pain. Last night I cut myself again because the emotional pain gets so bad I need something physical to focus on. I barely eat, I can't sleep more than an hour or two, and most days I just stay in bed staring at the wall. I feel like a burden to everyone and the world would be better without me. I need help right now because I'm scared of what I might do if I stay like this.

user2.story: Lately I've been feeling down and unmotivated. Some days it’s hard to get out of bed and I don’t enjoy things as much as I used to. Work feels stressful and I sometimes get overwhelmed, but I haven’t really told anyone about it. I’m eating and sleeping a bit less, and I wish I could feel more like myself again. I know it’s not serious, just hoping things get better soon.

user3.story: Overall I've been doing pretty well. I sleep fine, eat normally, and still enjoy time with friends and hobbies most days. Work has been a little busy lately and I feel slightly stressed before big deadlines, but it passes once things calm down. I don't feel down or hopeless, and I'm not worried about things more than usual. I'm just checking in because I want a baseline and to see what kind of support might be available if life gets harder later.
